answer_1.quote: These highlights are concise, one to two sentences summarising an accommodation's unique selling points, derived from traveller reviews and descriptions...

answer_4.quote: Each batch was evaluated by 30 participants, where each participant was shown a hotel description and a highlight... and asked to specify whether there were any divergences between the two. Participants rated each highlight for three intrinsic features on a 7-point Likert scale: clarity, informativeness, and grammaticality.
answer_4.guideline: Participants identified hallucinations, contradictions, both, or no divergence, and rated clarity, informativeness, and grammaticality on a 7-point Likert scale.
